name: Blancafort (Spain)
description: Red field charged with a white tower and a stripe of the four red bars on yellow along the fly.
history: The official flag of Blancafort is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with a first part of 19/24 of the length charged at the centre with the white tower with red door and windows of the arms, and a stripe of the bars of Aragon at the fly; approved on 1 July 2009 and published in the DOGC on 14 July 2009.

features.role: tower with red door and windows
stripe of four red pales on yellow along the fly
